note.title: Assessment Practice — France postcard
note.overview: Build the exact skills needed for the school-listed France postcard task, from sentence control to full timed-style practice.
learningGoals: Use negatives in the perfect tense.
Cover every task bullet in a concise postcard.
mustMemoriseRules: Use a past-time anchor + perfect tense for completed events.
Use c’était / j’ai aimé / j’ai adoré for past opinions.
Use ne…pas / ne…jamais / ne…rien around the auxiliary.
Use demain + near future or another justified future form.
A natural sign-off can be À bientôt ! or Bisous !
workedExamples: Hier, je suis arrivée à Paris. J’ai visité un musée.
C’était magnifique parce que j’adore l’histoire.
Demain, je vais découvrir un autre quartier.
commonMistakes: Writing a past event in the present tense.
Putting pas after the past participle instead of around the auxiliary.
Giving an opinion without a reason when the task asks for one.
Forgetting one of the postcard bullets.
detailedExplanation: This is an app-built assessment-practice topic. The curriculum scope is verified against the official Tiffin Girls’ School Year 9 French Curriculum Outline 2026-27.

Where the school outline names an assessment, it does not publish the teacher’s exact live paper or complete mark scheme. This app therefore practises the verified skills without claiming to reproduce the teacher’s paper.
French accents are corrected and displayed, but a missing accent alone does not lose the mark in this app.

The school outline identifies a 25-mark postcard from France. The exact teacher mark scheme is not public, so the app’s bullet/rubric checks are deliberately labelled practice rather than an official 25-mark marking grid.
examTips: Underline the time clue before choosing a tense.
Answer every bullet before adding ambitious detail.
Use accurate short sentences rather than risky long sentences.
quickCheck: Use negatives in the perfect tense.
beforeStartingPractice: Do the first attempt without notes. Use the explanation only after submitting.
